# Deferred research-entity realization plan

**Status:** PLAN (R2c, 2026-10-03). Source: `docs/research-gameplay-unlock-audit.md` §4 (generated by
`scripts/research-gameplay-unlock-audit.py`, checked in CI), which lists **115** research entities that content
declares but no system of this milestone realizes. Priority order A–G is the Director's (LOCKED decision 5);
the assignment of each entity to a tier and the reasons are INFERRED here by the implementing agent, not ruled.

**Newly realized in R2c: 0.** Every candidate below needs a full chain (prerequisite → legal availability →
authoritative simulation → UI where player-actionable → deterministic state → save/load → replay → tests); none
could be closed in this pass without either a new owning system, a new construction-effect model, or a
calibration-band risk the pass is forbidden to tune around. All 115 remain DEFERRED in the audit; nothing is
presented as implemented.

A realization rule for every tier: research completion grants KNOWLEDGE only (decision 6); the physical entity is
built through the existing order/construction pathway and its effect is a mechanism inside an existing
resolution equation, never a free-floating buff (law 2).

## A. Knowledge prerequisites of already-live loops with no physical realization

| entity | live loop it would close | owner / blocker |
|---|---|---|
| `infra.well` | settlement water → population growth / disease | needs a water-supply term in the population/health model (not modelled) |
| `building.kiln` | pottery firing (R1-gated recipe, live) | kiln as the capacity/fuel-efficiency term of the existing firing recipe; needs a construction project row + recipe link |
| `building.smithy` | bronze casting (R1-gated recipe, live) / toolmaking | same shape as kiln |
| `inst.archive`, `inst.scribal_school` | research stage / RP (live) | institutions system founding projects exist; needs an RP mechanism, not a flat bonus |
| `inst.census` | tax reach / assessment (live, ADR-033 D4) | collection-efficiency term inside the tax equation |

**First recommended slice:** `building.kiln` + `building.smithy` — both attach to recipes that are already
research-gated and live, so the chain is shortest. Blocker: the construction model has no per-building production
capacity term today; adding one is a new mechanism and needs its own packet.

## B. Buildings/institutions closing live economic/governance/population loops

The candidates are `building.mint`, `inst.mint_institution`,
`inst.coined_wage` (money/tax loop, ADR-033 D4), `inst.law_code`, `inst.legal_code_roman`, `inst.aramaic_admin`
(governance reach / unrest-lite brake, R2b), `building.library`, `inst.library`, `building.school` (research
stage), `building.city_wall` (revolt/defence — but the defensive effect is M7 combat (was "M6" before the 2026-10-03 rebase), so only its construction
would be M5), `building.harbour`, `building.lighthouse` (trade, now research-gated by R2a).

## C. Infrastructure with existing research, structurally important

`infra.basin_irrigation`, `infra.canal_irrigation`, `infra.terraces`, `infra.qanat` (agriculture; blocked behind
`farming.preCultivation`, committed OFF in R2a), `infra.bridge`, `infra.courier_relay` (transport — FROZEN at
997824b: a bridge or relay would change road rules, so it needs a director-ruled transport packet),
`infra.aqueduct`, `infra.sewer`, `infra.sewerage_system`, `infra.urban_drainage` (settlement growth/health),
`infra.navigation_canal`, `infra.railway`, `infra.telegraph_line`, `infra.telephone_network`, `infra.power_grid`,
`infra.fish_weir`, `activity.caravans`, `activity.coastal_shipping`, `activity.ocean_shipping` (logistics; caravans
and shipping are the natural next consumers of the R2a Trade gate but alter transport cost → frozen transport).
